description: Is the exhaustion gate pointing the wrong way? Live config requires heat >= 40 (ai_watch_exhaustion_heat_min_pct) with no ceiling, so the desk only enters names that are already hot. desk_report scored off 1m bars on 2026-08-20 says that is backwards: 0-25% exhaustion +0.309% (n=963) and 25-50% +0.334% (n=815) forward 30m, against 50-75% -0.626% (n=949) and 90-100% -0.591% (n=234). Admitted episodes overall came in at -0.623%. The floor excludes the only range with positive forward returns, and heating_too_low refused 527 arms that day. Corroborated by admission_null: the admission moment underperforms a random moment in the same name by 0.35% at 30m, 4.4 sigma. So sweep the floor DOWN as well as adding a ceiling. Exit knobs pinned at live so nothing can win through the trail. CAVEAT: the buckets are not monotonic (75-90% is +0.511%), the desk chose what it watched, and the sim has no spread — a win here is a forward-test hypothesis, not a config change.
